reviews.title: After paywall app linked to adult photos!!
reviews.text: I just tried to set up my family and it opened porn on my phone. Just after it asked for a subscription I clicked a button in the app and bide adult videos opened up. I am so glad the kids didn’t see and I am immediately deleting. What happened to family safe?!

reviews.title: Only useful if you pay extra
reviews.text: Many of the features that made me want to get this app are only available if you pay the extra monthly subscription fee. I might have been willing to pay for this app, but I’m not willing to pay rent on an app which started out by pulling a bait and switch.

reviews.title: App claims it’s free to use with upgrades available for a better experience, like a lot of apps. How
reviews.text: Tried it because of its claim as a great free app.However, if you want anything useful you’ll have to purchase upgrades. It’s aesthetically outdated. I don’t usually write reviews but it’s not worth your time.
